item.title: SCHEDULE OF REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS
item.description: The following is the schedule of Regular Council Meetings for 2026. Meetings commence at 7:30 p.m. and are held in City Hall Council Chambers at 3215 Eby Street. To be included on the Council agenda please complete a Delegation Request Form, which can be found on the City of Terrace website or provided in-person at City Hall, or call 250-638-4724. Agendas are posted at City Hall and on the City of Terrace Portal at www.terrace.ca/portal.
